_meta.status: REVIEW SAMPLE, not migrated. Not written to data/records.json, db/seed.sql or Supabase.
assumptions: severidad = 1 is a fixed default for this source, NOT a judgment read off the page. The page carries no severity signal of any kind.
id is provisional, assigned from 032 upward for review only. Nothing is reserved in data/records.json.
confidence = 1.0 as instructed. Note schema v2 defines confidence as confidence in the categoria and localizacion assigned, and here both come from the source rather than from interpretation.

fuente has two keys, { tipo, url }. Schema v2 documents fuente as three keys { tipo, url, grupo } and does not mark grupo optional, so schema.md needs an entry before this source merges. db/schema.sql already allows it: fuente_grupo is nullable.
categoria = urban_damage fixed for every item, as instructed. Some items are planned works or a peatonalizacion rather than damage.

lat, lng and precision come from the source page itself, not from geocoding. precision is set to address when the street string carries a number, else street, to stay inside the check constraint in db/schema.sql.
